title: Messages from a stream
description:
Split a TCP byte stream into whole messages with a length prefix.

```
received 3 bytes: (waiting)
received 6 bytes: message "hello"
received 9 bytes: message "hi", (waiting for 4 more)
received 4 bytes: message "abcd"
```
hints: Append to `m_pending`, then loop: while there are at least 2 bytes and the whole message is there, take it out (lesson 2.02).
`m_pending.erase(m_pending.begin(), m_pending.begin() + used)` removes what you handled.
requirements: Each message is a 2-byte big-endian length followed by that many bytes.
`class Framer` with `feed(bytes)` that returns every complete message and keeps the rest for later.
Data can arrive split anywhere, even in the middle of the length.
stretch: Refuse messages longer than 4096 bytes so a broken sender cannot use up memory.
